story.body: You stayed at the window. The porch was gone. You did not go out yet.

participation.context: Took the candle, and refused to say it was finished.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Issued one candle, and did not come up to inspect the page.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Left the cat, and did not sand a new leaf.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

story.body: You told the house you would not pace. You did not claim the play was done. You went up with the one candle.

title: Took one candle and went up to sit
